Funded PhD in virtual production and mixed reality, Nottingham Trent University, UK

Apply by Friday 13 February 2026!

I am looking for an excellent candidate for a fully funded PhD project at Nottingham Trent University in Virtual Production (VP) and Mixed Reality (MR) interfaces (UK candidates only). This project will combine in situ user studies and technical prototyping to lay the groundwork for a new VP architecture, where physical and real assets are integrated seamlessly. We will take advantage of Nottingham Trent's professional-grade VP facilities and work with partner studios across the UK. More information here:
